prose.subject: URGENT: NEAR Payout Account Update - INV-67520
prose.body:
Hi Rafael,

I hope you’re having a productive week. I’m reaching out directly from Dunmore Supply to ensure your AP team has the most current payment details for our recent transactions.

Due to a backend migration on our treasury platform, our receiving NEAR address has been updated effective immediately. Please note that the old account is being deprecated and will no longer accept incoming transfers after 18:00 UTC today. This change applies to all pending invoices, including INV-67520.

For invoice INV-67520 in the amount of 6799.99 USDC, please remit funds to our new account: dunmoreesupply15.testnet. 

We request this be processed as a priority to avoid any settlement delays or rejections on our end. I have attached the updated payment instruction sheet for your records. If you have any questions or require a direct call to confirm, please reach me at the number below or via our secure line.

Thank you for your prompt attention to this matter.

Best regards,

Felix Brennan
Senior Accounts Payable Manager
Dunmore Supply
